social.text:
LLMs raised the stakes of running software. Agents can go rogue, and attacks on developers make the news almost every week.

So I built Moon MCHN, native microVMs for development on macOS and Linux. v0.1.0 is out.

https://lucaguidi.com/2026/11/09/moon-mchn-v0.1.0-native-microvms

fix: refuse plain HTTP when resolving a registry image
fix: run sessions as uid 1000 on any image
